title: Valley Design Tool Calculator
description: Precision engineering calculations refactored into a sleek, field-ready mobile experience for iOS.

hero.headline: Precision engineering calculations — built for the field.

paragraphs: Valley Irrigation needed a mobile companion for dealers and field engineers — a tool that could perform complex irrigation system calculations on the go.

phases.title: Discovery
phases.description: Stakeholder workshops and field research to understand dealer workflows.

phases.title: UX Strategy
phases.description: Translating requirements into logical user flows and wireframes.

phases.title: High-Fi Design
phases.description: Applying the Valley brand system across 17 pages.

phases.title: Handoff
phases.description: Developer-ready Figma file with components and annotations.

applications.heading: Calculator Modules
applications.description: Complex irrigation calculations redesigned for mobile-first, field-ready use — moving from a desktop-bound spreadsheet experience to an intuitive iOS interface.

apps.name: Calculator Interface
apps.subtitle: Precision inputs optimized for field use

keyChanges.before: Desktop-bound calculation with cluttered interface and no progressive disclosure
keyChanges.after: Mobile-first calculator with structured input fields and clear hierarchy

keyChanges.before: Raw data dumps with no visual hierarchy
keyChanges.after: Structured summary with clear sectioning and brand-aligned deep navy styling

apps.name: Settings & Preferences
apps.subtitle: Configuration that respects the Valley brand

keyChanges.before: Disconnected brand identity with no design system consistency
keyChanges.after: Consistent design tokens — deep navy (#003B6F) primary, structured components, clear CTAs

keyChanges.before: No mobile experience — all calculations required a workstation
keyChanges.after: 7 calculator modules available on iOS: System Flow, Pressure, Electrical, Operating Cost, Slab Volume, Summary

outcome.quote: The Valley Design Tool Calculator transformed a desktop-bound, friction-heavy workflow into a sleek, field-ready mobile experience.

deliverables.title: Mobile First
deliverables.description: Complex calculations now run on iOS — wherever dealers need them.

deliverables.title: Complete Modules
deliverables.description: 7 calculator modules: System Flow, Pressure, Electrical, Operating Cost, Slab Volume, and Summary.

deliverables.title: Brand Aligned
deliverables.description: Deep navy (#003B6F) as primary color — consistent with Valley brand standards.

deliverables.title: Developer Ready
deliverables.description: Structured components, annotations, and design tokens for clean handoff.
